values: 一名急性子的法师，能够在战斗中制造风暴摧毁敌人。
A hotheaded Mage who unleashes raging storms to vanquish her enemies.
This place is under my watch!
The storm and I are one!
The breeze here... is quite gentle.
让我看看……是哪里的暴风雨没有停歇？
Let's see... where is the storm hitting hardest?
Hmm? Here comes another evil presence!
这东西不错，我会珍藏它的。
This is nice. I'll put it to good use.
真该让飓风摧毁这邪恶的东西。
I should destroy this vile thing with a hurricane.
竟然连风暴也无法撼动这里
Even the storm cannot shake this place.
Do they have fresh fish here?
每当海上出现风暴，卓琳都会前往附近，确保没有渔船遭遇危险。
Whenever a storm strikes at sea, Marene makes it her duty to ensure that no fishing boats are in danger.
虽然卓琳的飞行速度极快，但她最擅长的事其实是驾船、游泳和捕鱼。这是她在成为半神前最大的爱好，也是她赖以为生的手段。
Although Marene can fly at incredible speeds, her true talents lie in sailing, swimming, and fishing. Before becoming a Celestial, she pursued these as both her passion and her livelihood.
只要卓琳愿意，她可以随时随地制造一场足以引发海啸的风暴，哪怕是在深暗无光的海底。
Marene can summon storms and unleash tsunamis whenever and wherever she wishes, even in the darkest depths of the ocean.
卓琳是个不折不扣的急性子，行动总是犹如风暴一般迅捷。但偶尔，她也会驻足于孤岛的悬崖上，静静聆听海浪的声音。
Marene is impatient, always acting with the speed of a fierce storm. Even so, she occasionally enjoys taking a break atop a cliff, listening to the crashing waves.
许多渔民出海前都会在船头系上一块青蓝色的布，以此向卓琳祈求，庇佑他们安全归来。
Many fishermen tie a strip of blue-green cloth to the bow of their boats before heading out to sea, seeking Marene's blessing for a safe return.
卓琳原本并非卷发，是多年来的海风吹拂塑造了她如今的发型。
Marene was born with straight hair, but years of sea breeze have turned her locks curly.
“不要随意触碰卓琳，小心被游走于她皮肤上的雷电所伤。”——来自奥菲戈斯的告诫。
"Think twice before touching Marene, unless you want to get zapped by lightning coursing across her skin," Sylphira once warned.
身为凡人时，卓琳曾经信仰风浪与漂泊之神。但在亲眼目睹艾雅在神魔大战中为拯救众生而付出的努力后，她的信仰也随之改变。
As a mortal, Marene worshiped the god of the waves. However, her faith changed after she witnessed Dura's tireless efforts to save lives during the Divine War.
很少有人见过卓琳的笑容，巴赫朗和亚莉克希都曾为逗笑她而绞尽脑汁，但两人皆以失败告终。
Hardly anyone has ever seen Marene smile. Both Baelran and Aliceth have gone to great lengths to make her laugh, but to no avail.
卓琳喜欢贝壳制成的装饰品，尤其是贝壳串成的风铃。当风吹过，贝壳互相碰撞，会交织出一首只属于大海的歌。
Marene loves seashell ornaments, especially wind chimes. When the wind stirs them, the shells clink together, singing a song dedicated to the ocean.
Do they have fresh fish here?
